facts.heading: BENCHMARK METHODOLOGY
parts: BENCHMARK METHODOLOGY
How the Tender Intelligence Benchmark is run.

Pilot evaluations are conducted with tender consultancy firms and EPC bid teams using real procurement documents. Each tender is processed with the same requirements, and outputs are reviewed blind by experienced tender professionals, who are not told which system produced which output. Results are published only after the evaluation process is complete.
Why tender AI needs a domain-specific benchmark
General benchmarks measure the wrong thing.
Reasoning and coding scores don't show whether a system caught the turnover threshold buried in a corrigendum.
Errors are costly and lopsided.
A missed eligibility clause can disqualify a bid, and a wrong Go or No-Go wastes drafting effort or forfeits a winnable contract.

parts: What is Ficungini?
Ficungini is a tender intelligence workspace that helps you decide whether to bid, surface compliance requirements, and organize the evidence needed to build a stronger response.
How is pricing calculated?
The Individual plan is a fixed monthly subscription with the full platform and monthly usage limits. Business plans are quoted around your team size, workspace needs, and deployment scope.
Is my tender data secure?
Ficungini applies encryption, access controls, and security monitoring to protect tender information. Your documents and analyses remain scoped to your organization's workspace.
Can multiple people collaborate on a bid?
Yes. Business workspaces give consultants, reviewers, and sign-off leads a shared source of truth for tender documents, findings, and bid decisions.

Can multiple people collaborate on a bid? Yes. Business workspaces give consultants, reviewers, and sign-off leads a shared source of truth for tender documents, findings, and bid decisions.

parts: Does it work for private and public tenders?
Yes. Ficungini is designed for RFPs, RFQs, corrigenda, and technical specifications across public procurement and private EPC or OEM bids.
What happens after my daily free analysis?
You can wait for the next day's complimentary analysis or choose a paid plan to continue reviewing tenders beyond the daily free credit.
